intro.t: In Part 3, someone has to start, and someone has to move the talk on. Make it you. Six ways to open an idea, or move to the next one.

close.t: Nice work. In the real exam, be the one who starts. The examiner notices.

reels.note: Works in anyone's mouth. Name the option, then say one thing about it.

ex.t: {Shall we start with} learning online? I think it's really useful, especially for homework.
ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how useful these things are for teenagers.
ex.scene: How useful are these for teenagers? · learning online · keeping in touch with friends · finding information · being creative · staying healthy

ex.t: {Shall we start with} babysitting? It's quite popular with teenagers.
ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how good these ideas are for teenagers who want to earn money.
ex.scene: How good are these ideas for teenagers who want to earn money? · working in a café · babysitting · selling things online · helping in a family business · giving lessons to younger children

ex.t: {Shall we start with} healthier school meals? That seems like the most obvious one.
ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how effective these ideas would be in helping students to be healthier.
ex.scene: How effective would these ideas be in helping students to be healthier? · healthier school meals · more PE lessons · an after-school sports club · lessons about mental health · banning fizzy drinks

ex.t: {Why don't we start with} getting enough sleep? People always forget about it.
ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how helpful these ideas might be when preparing for exams.
ex.scene: How helpful might these be when preparing for exams? · studying with friends · getting a tutor · using apps and videos · making a study timetable · getting enough sleep

ex.t: {Why don't we start with} recycling at home? It's the easiest one to do.

ex.t: {Why don't we start with} eating meals together? My family does that every evening.
ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how enjoyable these ways of spending time together are for teenagers.
ex.scene: How enjoyable are these ways for teenagers to spend time with their families? · eating meals together · going on holiday · playing games at home · doing sport together · visiting grandparents
